_note: The machine owns the numbers. bead and lh are NOT free parameters of a design — they are properties of a calibrated printer, and every geometry rule (rho, tip floor, self-approach, node gap, bridge budget) is derived from them. beadSource says whether the number was measured in plastic or assumed; anything built on an assumed bead is a guess wearing a report.
